name: Windows Password Complexity Enabled (Local Policy)
description:
Ensures the local security policy requires complex passwords (PasswordComplexity = 1).
Required Windows permission: the LEA agent account must be allowed to run secedit /export /areas SECURITYPOLICY USER_RIGHTS (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

validation.command: $f = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName(); secedit /export /areas SECURITYPOLICY USER_RIGHTS /cfg $f /quiet | Out-Null; Get-Content $f; Remove-Item $f -Force
